title: 第1章 三生三世裂甲重生第2章 唐门弟子张三
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
大决战，嘉陵关。
“我不服！我不服！”
在武魂帝国大军的军帐外，一黑发青年看着天空那即将溃败的天使神和罗刹神，发出了不甘的咆哮！
我们武魂殿早已胜券在握，为何还会输？！
明明那海神唐三已被杀了，为什么他还能回来？
凭什么他还能赢？！
“果然，不愧是唐三啊……”
胡列娜紧握着颤抖双手，尽管她看到了她视之如母的恩师罗刹神比比东被其重创垂死，正心伤不已，但她还是不由得对那个男人发出一声赞叹。
这个男人是将所有天才甩到天边的妖孽，是这斗罗大陆上真正且唯一的主角。
自己本欲与其争锋，甚至还对其动了情愫，现在看来自己也不过是个笑话。
接着胡列娜克制着自己的情绪，在帅营中对众武魂帝国将士们说道：
“传令下去，我军放下武器，派使臣，向天斗帝国投降。”
然而营帐外的黑发青年立刻回到帐内，并上前两步单膝跪在胡列娜身前，瞪着布满血丝的双眼向其说道：
“圣女殿下！我们还有十万大军，还有数名封号斗罗，帝国国祚未绝，我们还能一战！”
“一战？”
胡列娜嗤笑一声，她摇头转身仰视那尊天使神像说道：
“双神都已战败，武魂帝国大势已去，我们都只是凡人罢了，不要再做无谓的牺牲了。”
然后她用眼角瞥了一眼那位黑发青年，向其下令道：
“张三，我命你代表我军去和天斗皇帝交涉。”
结果跪在地上的青年却冷冷的说道：“我是不会投降的。”

“什么？”
胡列娜顿时一惊，一贯以自己马首是瞻的张三今天居然出言违抗了自己的命令。
“我绝不会向唐三认输！”
冷峻的黑发青年站了起来，他先看了一眼用惊讶以及疑惑的目光注视着自己的胡列娜，然后将视线转向了其他也一样一脸诧异的看着自己的武魂帝国长老和众将领们，他那本老实忠厚的双眼中现在尽是轻蔑。
胡列娜怒斥道：“张三！你要造反吗？！”
“呃？！”
然而接着张三做出了让胡列娜更为诧异的举动，他亮起了自己魂环，黄、黄、紫、紫、黑，五个魂环出现在他身后。
“大胆狂徒！敢对圣女不敬！？”
其他武魂帝国长老和将领们顿时一怒，他们在身后展露的魂环几乎没一个在五环之下，甚至有一位九环的封号斗罗。
然而张三并未看向他们，好像这些强者身上那可以让自己窒息的威压不存在一样。
“鬼龙，附体！”
张三大喝一声，展开了自己的武魂，一对丑陋而充满疙瘩的黑色翅膀出现在其身后，而其手脚上则都出现了利爪。
敢在帅营内亮武魂，分明是要造反。
“找死！”
就在众人打算对张三下手时，张三却振翅而飞，向那云端飞去。
content_en:
The decisive battle, Jialing Pass.
"I don't accept it! I don't accept it!"
Outside the military tent of the Spirit Empire army, a young man with black hair looked at the angel gods and Rakshasa gods in the sky who were about to be defeated, and roared unwillingly!
Our Wuhun Palace has already secured victory, so why do we still lose? !
The sea god Tang San has obviously been killed, why can he come back?
Why can he still win? !
"Sure enough, he is indeed Tang San..."
Hu Liena clenched her trembling hands. Although she was heartbroken to see Bibi Dong, the Rakshasa God who she regarded as a mother, being severely injured and dying, she could not help but praise the man.
This man is the monster who throws all geniuses to the edge of the sky, and is the real and only protagonist in this Douluo Continent.
He originally wanted to compete with him, and even had feelings for him, but now it seems that he is just a joke.
Then Hu Liena restrained her emotions and said to the Spirit Empire soldiers in the commander's camp:
"Here you go, our army lays down its weapons, sends envoys, and surrenders to the Tiandou Empire."
However, the black-haired young man outside the tent immediately returned to the tent, took two steps forward, knelt on one knee in front of Hu Liena, stared at her with bloodshot eyes and said to her:
"Your Highness the Saint! We still have an army of 100,000, and several titled Douluo. The empire is still in ruins, and we can still fight!"
"A battle?"
Hu Liena sneered, shook her head, turned around, looked up at the angel statue and said:
"Both gods have been defeated. The Spirit Empire is doomed. We are all just mortals. Don't make any more unnecessary sacrifices."
Then she glanced at the black-haired young man from the corner of her eye and ordered to him:
"Zhang San, I order you to negotiate with Emperor Tiandou on behalf of our army."
As a result, the young man kneeling on the ground said coldly: "I will not surrender."
"What?"
Hu Liena was immediately shocked. Zhang San, who always followed his own lead, actually disobeyed her orders today.
"I will never admit defeat to Tang San!"
The stern black-haired young man stood up. He first glanced at Hu Liena, who was looking at him with surprise and confusion, and then turned his attention to the other Spirit Empire elders and generals who were also looking at him in surprise. His honest and loyal eyes were now filled with contempt.
Hu Liena angrily shouted: "Zhang San! Are you going to rebel?!"
"Huh?!"
However, then Zhang San made a move that surprised Hu Liena even more. He lit up his soul ring. Five soul rings, yellow, yellow, purple, purple and black, appeared behind him.
"Bold maniac! How dare you disrespect the saint!?"
The other elders and generals of the Spirit Empire were immediately furious. Almost none of the spirit rings they displayed behind them were below the fifth ring, and there was even a nine-ring titled Douluo.
However, Zhang San did not look at them, as if the pressure on these strong men that could suffocate him did not exist.
"Ghost dragon, possessed!"
Zhang San shouted loudly and unfolded his martial spirit. A pair of ugly and bumpy black wings appeared behind him, and sharp claws appeared on his hands and feet.
If you dare to show your martial arts spirit in the commander's camp, you are clearly planning to rebel.
"Seeking death!"
Just when everyone was about to attack Zhang San, Zhang San flapped his wings and flew towards the clouds.
